concepts.definition: a word that has the same or nearly the same meaning as another word
a word that has the opposite meaning of another word
the grammatical matching of a subject and verb in number and person
a verb form that helps show the time of an action, event, or state
the use of marks in writing to organize sentences and clarify meaning
the central point or most important message communicated by a passage
a conclusion reached from evidence and clues that are not stated directly
the accepted arrangement of letters used to write a word correctly
the task of choosing or supplying language that makes an incomplete sentence grammatically and logically complete
the set of words a learner understands and can use appropriately
